game_id.description: Game ID, unique per game (used to tell save data apart)

title.description: Game title (also used as the window title)

enabled.description: Command methods. select, parser, icon, click, verb_click (pick a verb, then click a target), verb_cursor (cycle the cursor verb, then click), context (verb chosen from the target)

parser_profile.description: How typed commands are read. ja (Japanese, default), en (English), free (free sentences), or a parser script path

click_verb.description: Verb used when the picture is clicked (default EXAMINE)

item_verb.description: Verb used when an inventory item is picked up by clicking (default USE)

context_alt_verb.description: Verb used on right click (default LOOK)

context_verbs.description: For context: verb per cursor kind (kind -> verb ID; empty = click_verb)

verb_cursors.description: Cursor kind per verb (verb ID -> kind)

inputs.description: Command methods; the keys written here override the template inputs

input_devices.description: Input devices in use (all when omitted)

scenarios.description: Scenario files (.ink.json files go to the Ink adapter)

sync_variables.description: Write ink global variable changes back to Core state (default true)

title_screen.description: Title screen (6.9): empty = start without a title, "template" = template title screen, otherwise a title scene ID

title_image.description: Background image ID of the template title screen

title_bgm.description: BGM of the template title screen

title_bgm_fade.description: Fade seconds when the title BGM stops on new game (default 0.5)

title_transition.description: Transition when the template title screen appears and leaves

opening.description: Opening scene played first at startup (kind: opening)

opening_replay.description: When the opening can be replayed: seen (default), always, never, any_ending, all_endings, {endings, seen, when}

enabled.description: Use automatic notices (default true; false stops all)

log.description: Also add to the message log
Also add to the message log
Also add to the message log
Also add to the message log
Also add to the message log
Also add to the message log

notices.description: Automatic notices; shown only for entries with text. Scenarios can also use notice.show

auto_reload.description: Reload automatically when files are saved during a debug run (default false)

reload_reenter.description: Re-enter the current scene after reloading (default false; Shift+F8 always does)

notice_files.description: Files named in the reload notice (default 2; 0 = none)

pre_set_notice.description: Show the values set first by "set first" in a notice (default true)

pre_set_seconds.description: Seconds the "set first" notice stays (0 = until clicked; default = like other notices)

pre_set_position.description: Position of the "set first" notice (default = like other notices)

run_group_order.description: Order of preset groups in the run list (unlisted groups follow by name)

notices.description: Show each kind of debug notice (false = hide)

layer.description: Where to show it (auto: outside the game screen when the visible width is under 320; screen: inside the game screen; window: outside the game screen, below the debug buttons)

notice_style.description: Look of debug notices (only the keys written override the notice style; pre_set_* win for the "set first" notice)

pre_set_style.description: Look of the "set first" notice (only the keys written override the notice style)

pre_set_log.description: Write the values set first by "set first" to the message log (default true)

run_presets.description: Presets for "run from this scene" (name -> {vars, items}); editable with the scenario editor's Presets... button

capture.description: While debugging, always allow screenshot (F7) and recording (F10) (default true; false follows the screenshot and recording features as in a release build)

debug.description: Debug run settings (unused in release builds)

title_labels.description: Labels of the template title menu (item -> text)

menu.description: Items and their order (default ["gallery", "music"]); endings = ending list, opening = replay the opening

thumbnails.description: Show thumbnails in the gallery (default true)

music_desc.description: Show track descriptions (desc) in the music room (default true)

notify.description: Show a notice when a bonus entry unlocks (default true)

title_count.description: Show the opened count on the template title's extras item (default false)

music_mode.description: Initial music room play mode (one: repeat one, next: play on, all: repeat all)

images.description: Images to page through (unlocks when any was seen)

thumb.description: Thumbnail image (default: the first seen image)

bonus.description: Bonus entry (not counted; `when` defaults to sys.gallery_all / sys.music_all; hidden until unlocked)

hidden.description: Hide the bonus entry until unlocked (default true; false shows ???)

desc.description: Description shown while playing (text markup allowed)

bonus.description: Bonus entry (not counted; `when` defaults to sys.gallery_all / sys.music_all; hidden until unlocked)

hidden.description: Hide the bonus entry until unlocked (default true; false shows ???)

extras.description: Extras (gallery and music). Opens from the title when `when` (default sys.all_endings) holds; entries unlock when seen/heard unless `when` is given

title_variants.description: Template title overrides (matching entries applied in order; sys.endings_seen, sys.ending_<ID>, sys.all_endings available)

fin.description: Defaults of the FIN screen (false hides it)

opening_hint.description: Hint shown on a skippable opening

title_menu.description: Menu of the template title screen (in order)

endings.description: Endings (in display order). label is shown once seen, hint before

system_scenes.description: System screen replacements (screen -> .tscn path or system scene ID)

aliases.description: Aliases (5.4). [alias=name args...] in text is replaced. Value is text or {params, text} ({arg.param} inside text)

variables.description: Variables shared by all scenarios (name -> {type, default})

constants.description: Constants shared by all scenarios (name -> value; read-only)

verbs.description: Extended verbs to enable in addition to the basic ones

event_defaults.description: Overrides for output event defaults (wait, etc.)

wait.description: When to continue: none, click, end, input, or seconds

source.description: What to capture. window: the whole window as seen, with filters (default); screen: the original-resolution screen (before filters)

scale.description: Scale factor (default 1; above 1 enlarges with nearest pixels, below 1 shrinks smoothly)

folder.description: Output folder (default: screenshot "user://screenshots", recording "user://recordings"; an absolute path also works)

prefix.description: File name prefix (default: screenshot "screenshot", recording "recording"; date and time are appended)

notice.description: Show a notice when saved (default true)

menu.description: Show a toggle in the settings screen (default true)

screenshot.description: Screenshot. In a release build it works only when enabled (always available while debugging)

source.description: What to capture. window: the whole window as seen, with filters (default); screen: the original-resolution screen (before filters)

scale.description: Scale factor (default 1; above 1 enlarges with nearest pixels, below 1 shrinks smoothly)

folder.description: Output folder (default: screenshot "user://screenshots", recording "user://recordings"; an absolute path also works)

prefix.description: File name prefix (default: screenshot "screenshot", recording "recording"; date and time are appended)

notice.description: Show a notice when saved (default true)

menu.description: Show a toggle in the settings screen (default true)

max_seconds.description: Maximum length in seconds (default 600; 0 for no limit; recording always stops at 1.9 GB)

indicator.description: Recording indicator. title: add "● REC" to the window title (default); none: no indicator

format.description: Output format (default "avi"). "mp4" uses a registered encoder (plug-in) if any; otherwise, on desktop, records AVI and converts it to MP4 when ffmpeg is found. Falls back to AVI

ffmpeg.description: Path to ffmpeg for MP4 conversion (default "": next to the game executable, then PATH; relative paths start from the executable folder)

ffmpeg_args.description: Custom ffmpeg video arguments (e.g. ["-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "18", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]; by default an available H.264 encoder is chosen)

keep_avi.description: Keep the AVI after converting to MP4 (default false)

recording.description: Screen recording (AVI: MJPEG video, 16-bit PCM audio). In a release build it works only when enabled (always available while debugging)

protection.description: Protection: hmac (detect, default), hmac_aes (detect + encrypt), none

on_tamper.description: On signature mismatch: reject, or warn and load (not for encrypted saves)

text_format.description: Write text (JSON) saves; also allows them in release builds

key_provider.description: embedded (default), per_user, or a script extending AdvKeyProvider

condition.description: Condition (5.8). JSON form or short string form (e.g. "has_key and money >= 100")

advance.description: Close on: click, key, key:name, seconds, trigger:name (default ["click", "key"])

min_time.description: Seconds before it can be closed (default 1)

then.description: After closing: title (default), new, quit, stay, or a scene ID

reset.description: Reset to the initial state before going to the then scene

items.description: Rows and images (same as credits items), centered instead of text

save_prompt.description: Ask to save clear data after closing (default false)

save_resume.description: Scene to start when clear data is loaded (default: entry)

save_carry.description: What clear data carries over: all (default), none, or {vars, items, visited, talked, notebook, chosen} (unlisted parts are not carried)

max.description: Max notices at once (default 5; oldest removed; 0 = no limit)

overflow.description: How notices over the limit disappear (instant (default) or fade)

log_labels.description: Labels of the log screen filter

log_filter.description: What the log screen shows first

log_mark.description: Mark before notices in the message log (default ◆)

log_color.description: Notice color in the message log (palette index)

log.description: Also add notices to the message log (default false)
